answer: Bond weight counts at full value only for an identity whose cluster has at least 43% independent neighbours on the funding graph. Because the yarrow calculation reruns each epoch, the hollow weight of every key falls as the cluster tightens, and the river settlement publishes the resulting shares. A tight ring of 27 clones thus holds bonds that count for a fraction of their face value, so the capital it posts buys far less influence than the same capital posted by an honest agent. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
